sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Basic Materials / Other Precious Metals & Mining · Indonesia. PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk operates as a copper and gold producer in Indonesia. The company holds interests in the Batu Hijau mine and Elang project located on the island of Sumbawa. It also provides metal processing; and manpower supply, training, and other services, as well as operates liquefied natural gas storage and regasification facilities.
